description: This file defines a Razor PageModel class for handling user logout functionality in an ASP.NET Core web application. It manages sign-out operations, cache management, and redirect after logout.

classes.name: LogoutModel
classes.description: A Razor PageModel class managing user logout process, including sign-out, cache update, and redirection.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests; currently does nothing.

methods.name: OnPost
methods.description: Handles POST logout requests, performs sign-out, cache update, logging, and redirects accordingly.
